label: PF Backlog 625
title: precheck: a derived/bookkeeping-only tier (docs-fresh + compile only) so doc/backlog regeneration never runs the full gate
body: Derived/bookkeeping changes (BACKLOG-SUMMARY.md, documentation-index.html, open/closed.json, counters, history) are neutrally regenerated, yet a doc-only PR currently runs the full fast precheck (all gates + scoped tests) and can even conflict as its own PR. Requirement: when a change is BOOKKEEPING/DERIVED-ONLY (no source, no tests, only generated docs + backlog stores), precheck should run a MINIMAL tier (docs-fresh + compile) - not the full gate. Also: never split doc regeneration into its own PR; the pre-commit hook already regenerates+stages the derived docs with a backlog change, so commit WITH hooks (no --no-verify) so they ride together.

brief.problem: Doc/backlog regen changes run the full gate and can conflict as separate PRs.
brief.why: Doc-only changes should be cheap and never a separate PR.

objective: Add a derived/bookkeeping-only precheck tier (docs-fresh + compile) and stop doc-regen running the full gate.
acceptance_criteria: precheck detects a derived/bookkeeping-only change and runs only docs-fresh + compile (fast, no scoped tests, no area gates).
A backlog change regenerates the derived docs in the SAME commit via the pre-commit hook (no separate doc PR, no --no-verify).
Full fast gate still runs for any change touching source/tests/config.

approach: precheck: a derived/bookkeeping-only tier (docs-fresh + compile only) so doc/backlog regeneration never runs the full gate
verification: Objective achieved: precheck: a derived/bookkeeping-only tier (docs-fresh + compile only) so doc/backlog regeneration never runs the full gate
